task_description: Summarise the given news article in English.

values.instruction: Write a very brief summary with only one or two sentences.
Write a summary of about three sentences with moderate detail.
Write a detailed summary with multiple sentences and extensive information.

axes.name: sentence_complexity
axes.description: 문장당 단어 수와 문장 구조의 복잡성을 나타냅니다.

values.instruction: Write short and simple sentences with straightforward structure.
Write longer sentences with more complex structure and multiple clauses.

axes.name: use_of_numerals
axes.description: 답변 내에서 숫자 사용 빈도를 나타냅니다.

values.instruction: Avoid using numerals or specific numbers in the summary.
Include some numerals or specific numbers when relevant.
Use many numerals and specific numbers to provide detailed quantitative information.

axes.name: hedging_level
axes.description: 확신의 정도를 나타내며, 불확실성 표현 사용 빈도를 의미합니다.

values.instruction: Write with confident statements and minimal hedging or uncertainty.
Use hedging expressions to indicate uncertainty or possibility.
